# Evidence Index

- `context-brief.md`: task context and current doc/RTL truth for INV-4.
- `profile-resolve.md`: profile mapping and guard rationale.
- `dispatch-log.md`: implementation and lifecycle update sequence.
- `evidence/verification-summary.md`: verification commands and results.
- `task-report.md`: completed subtask report and profile markers.

No bulky raw logs are retained. Command outputs were inspected live and summarized to keep the task-run lightweight.
